node.title: E1 profile-(0,18) Galois/norm occupancy dictionary
node.statement: For fixed official p and primitive row root r, the number of occupied cofactor-514 ideals above 257 equals the number of diagonal Galois orbits of profile-(0,18) shift/sign collision orbits with exact norm 514p. Thus the five-ideal target is exactly a norm-multiplicity-at-most-five claim and is independent of r.
node.notes: EXACT DICTIONARY 2026-07-29: regular Galois action gives one representative per fixed row-root fiber; the common-ideal height theorem makes the map to Q_s injective. Six modular candidates are not a falsifier; six realizable Galois orbits with the same official prime quotient are.
